qt: to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) Subject:

Were Commission President Ursula von der Leyen’s chief communication adviser or employees from his department involved in creating social media content for Ursula von der Leyen about European People’s Party events?
at: (English version) to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) (7 November 2025) Subject: Involvement of Commission President’s communications team in social media content about European People’s Party Were Commission President Ursula von der Leyen’s chief communication adviser or employees from his department involved in creating social media content for Ursula von der Leyen about European People’s Party events? (27 March 2026) As the Commission noted in its replies to written questions E-001836/2025 (1) and E-003234/2025 (2), the President of the Commission attends European People’s Party events in the official capacity as President of the Commission. The President’s social media team is in charge of producing social media content for the President’s accounts in the context of her official capacity as President of the Commission.
